# Phase 4 contract (internal, for parallel implementation)

Same rules as CONTRACT.md / PHASE3_CONTRACT.md. CI builds with Xcode 26.x on macos-15-intel (so `#if compiler(>=6.2)` is true; still guard iOS 26 APIs with `#available`). Deployment target iOS 18. Nobody compiles locally. Japanese UI. App name "Video Mania".

## Shared model (already written — read, do NOT edit)
- `Sources/Model/Phase4Models.swift`: MaskShape/MaskSettings, ReframeSample/ReframeTrack (center(at:)), StabilizationSample/StabilizationTrack (sample(at:)), ClipEnhancements, DepthParallax/ParallaxDirection, AutoEditStyle/AutoEditSettings, HighlightSegment, ScriptTone/ScriptLine.
- `Clip` new fields: `mask`, `reframe`, `stabilization`, `enhance`, `parallax` (all defaulted; included in ==/duplicated()).
- `OverlayClip` new fields: `mask`, `parallax`.
- Existing from phase 3: `AudioEffects.noiseReduction` (0...1) — now to be implemented as real spectral noise reduction; `SubtitlePolisher.translate(_:from:toEnglish:settings:)` exists (AI translation) but is not wired in the UI yet; `AppSettings.shared` (engines, OpenAI key).

## Partitions

### V — Engine video (files: VideoCompositor.swift, OverlayRenderer.swift, FilterEngine.swift, CompositionBuilder.swift (instruction data only), new MaskRenderer.swift, DepthParallaxRenderer.swift, EnhanceFilters.swift)
- Masks for clips and overlays: MaskRenderer builds a cached CIImage alpha mask (shape at center/width/height/rotation with feather via CIGaussianBlur on the mask, inverted) in render pixels and applies with CIBlendWithMask (clip: mask against black/transparent canvas → shows background black; overlay: masks the overlay). Shapes: circle (ellipse), rectangle, roundedRectangle, linear (half-plane with feather), mirror (band), star, heart (UIBezierPath → CGImage).
- Auto reframe: when `clip.reframe.isActive` and the canvas scaling is `.fill` OR the canvas aspect differs from the clip aspect, compute the crop window: size = canvas aspect fitted inside the clip frame divided by `reframe.zoom`, centered on `reframe.center(at: sourceTime)` smoothed with an exponential filter over time (use smoothing: keep a per-track last center in the compositor, alpha = 1 - smoothing) and clamped inside the frame; replace the normal fit/fill transform for that clip.
- Stabilization: when `clip.stabilization.isActive`, per frame get `sample(at: sourceTime)` and apply translation (dx*width, dy*height) and rotation about the center scaled by `strength`, then scale by `cropZoom` about the center so edges stay covered.
- Enhancements: `denoise` → CINoiseReduction (inputNoiseLevel 0.02*d, inputSharpness 0.4) applied before filters; `sharpenUpscale` → CILanczosScaleTransform is not needed (output size is the canvas) — apply CIUnsharpMask (radius 2.5, intensity 0.3+0.7*s) after the fit when the source is smaller than the canvas, else a mild CISharpenLuminance; `retouch` → face-aware smoothing: use the `faceRects` provided per frame? Too slow per frame — instead the UI runs `FaceRegionAnalyzer` (partition A) once to get ReframeSample-like face rects over time stored in... keep it simple: apply a skin-tone-masked smoothing (CIColorCube-style skin mask from hue 5°–45°, sat 0.15–0.75) blended with a CIGaussianBlur (radius 3+5*r) at opacity r*0.8 — no face detection needed. Document the approximation.
- Depth parallax: `DepthParallaxRenderer.image(for url: URL, maxPixel:) -> (image: CIImage, depth: CIImage?)` reads the photo and its depth/disparity auxiliary map via `CGImageSourceCopyAuxiliaryDataInfoAtIndex` (kCGImageAuxiliaryDataTypeDisparity/Depth) → CIImage; when present and `parallax.enabled`, render a layered parallax: foreground (near pixels, from depth threshold with feathered mask) moves/zooms more than background (CIDisplacementDistortion or two-layer transform by depth-weighted offset `strength * progress`). Without depth, fall back to Ken Burns zoom. Used for still clips (`clip.parallax`) and image overlays (`overlay.parallax`).
- Keep public signatures; add instruction fields as plain values.

### A — Analysis & AI (new files: VisionReframe.swift, MotionTracker.swift, Stabilizer.swift, HighlightAnalyzer.swift, AutoEditor.swift, ScriptWriter.swift; edit: AudioEffectsRenderer.swift (spectral noise reduction), SubtitlePolisher.swift (expose translate already there; add `static func summarize(_ text: String, settings:) async -> String?`))
```swift
enum VisionReframe { static func analyze(clip: Clip, step: Double = 0.25, progress: ((Double) -> Void)?) async throws -> ReframeTrack }   // VNDetectHumanRectanglesRequest + VNDetectFaceRectanglesRequest on frames sampled every `step` s via AVAssetImageGenerator (maximumSize 640); choose the largest/most central subject; fill gaps by holding the last center; confidence from observation; samples in SOURCE seconds; returns track with enabled = true
enum MotionTracker { static func track(url: URL, start: Double, end: Double, initialRect: NormalizedRect /* top-left normalized at `start` */, fps: Double = 15, progress: ((Double) -> Void)?) async throws -> [Keyframe] }   // VNTrackObjectRequest with VNSequenceRequestHandler over frames from AVAssetReader (or AVAssetImageGenerator at fps); returns keyframes with time RELATIVE to `start` and center = rect center (Vision uses bottom-left origin — convert); scale = 1; stops when confidence < 0.3 for > 0.5 s (keeps last)
enum Stabilizer { static func analyze(clip: Clip, fps: Double = 30, progress: ((Double) -> Void)?) async throws -> StabilizationTrack }   // consecutive-frame VNTranslationalImageRegistrationRequest (or homographic → extract rotation) on downscaled frames via AVAssetReader; accumulate camera path; smooth with a Gaussian window (±15 frames); correction = smoothed − raw, normalized by frame size; samples in SOURCE seconds; enabled true, cropZoom 1.1
enum HighlightAnalyzer { static func analyze(snapshot: ProjectSnapshot, settings: AutoEditSettings, progress: ((Double) -> Void)?) async throws -> [HighlightSegment] }   // per clip: loudness envelope (AudioAnalysis), speech presence (RMS/zero-crossing or subtitles overlap), motion (frame difference on 320px frames at 4 fps), faces (VNDetectFaceRectanglesRequest at 1 fps); score segments of 2–6 s; return sorted by start
enum AutoEditor {
    static func build(snapshot: ProjectSnapshot, settings: AutoEditSettings, highlights: [HighlightSegment]?, progress: ((Double) -> Void)?) async throws -> ProjectSnapshot   // returns a NEW snapshot: clips trimmed to chosen highlights to reach targetDuration (if 0 keep all), transitions by style (documentary: fadeBlack/dissolve 0.6; short: none/zoom 0.25; vlog: dissolve 0.4), BGM beat-aligned cuts when useBGMBeats and audio.bgmURL != nil (BeatDetector), title card at start when addTitleCard, look applied when applyLook (DocumentaryStyle recommended for documentary/family; vlog: cinematicWarm; short: vivid filter), ducking on for speech styles
    static func slideshow(images: [URL], perImageSeconds: Double, settings: AutoEditSettings, bgm: URL?) async throws -> ProjectSnapshot   // still clips (stillImageURL, duration 3600, endTime = perImageSeconds) with alternating Ken Burns-like animation (clip.animation zoomIn/out), transitions, BGM
    struct Template: Identifiable { let id: String; let name: String; let description: String; let settings: AutoEditSettings; let kind: FormatKind? }
    static let templates: [Template]   // 6 built-ins (ドキュメンタリー60秒, 旅Vlog 90秒, ショート15秒, 家族の1日, 商品紹介, 対談ダイジェスト)
}
enum ScriptWriter {
    static func write(topic: String, durationSeconds: Double, tone: ScriptTone, subtitles: [SubtitleCue], markers: [TimelineMarker], settings: AppSettings) async throws -> [ScriptLine]   // FoundationModels on iOS 26 (LanguageModelSession) else OpenAI chat (gpt-4o-mini) with the user's key else throws ScriptWriterError.noEngine (Japanese message); prompt asks for N lines with approximate times as JSON
    static func outline(from subtitles: [SubtitleCue], settings: AppSettings) async throws -> [TimelineMarker]   // chapter suggestions (kind .chapter)
}
```
- Spectral noise reduction in AudioEffectsRenderer: when `effects.noiseReduction > 0`, STFT (vDSP FFT, 1024 window, 75% overlap) → noise profile = 10th percentile magnitude per bin over the file → spectral gating (subtract profile × (1 + 2×nr), floor 0.1) → ISTFT; then the existing EQ/pitch chain. Keep the public API.

### P — Persistence (file: ProjectStore.swift)
Persist Clip.mask/reframe/stabilization/enhance/parallax and OverlayClip.mask/parallax (optional with defaults; samples arrays as compact arrays of numbers). Keep old files loading.

### U — UI (files: ContentView.swift, EditorToolbar.swift, EditorPanels.swift, ClipFXPanels.swift, OverlayPanels.swift, TextPanels.swift, PreviewGestureOverlay.swift, SubtitleEditorView.swift; new: MaskPanels.swift, AutoEditViews.swift, ScriptWriterView.swift)
- Clip selection: 「マスク」 panel (shape chips, size/feather/rotation sliders, invert, drag on preview via PreviewGestureOverlay to move the mask center when the mask panel is open), 「自動リフレーム」 (explain; 「解析」 button → VisionReframe.analyze with progress overlay → sets clip.reframe; toggle enabled; smoothing/zoom sliders; note it takes effect when canvas aspect differs or scaling is 埋める), 「手ぶれ補正」 (「解析」 → Stabilizer.analyze; toggle; strength; cropZoom), 「画質」 (denoise/retouch/sharpenUpscale sliders with explanations). Still clips: 「3Dズーム」 (DepthParallax toggle/strength/direction; show 「この写真には奥行き情報がありません(ケン・バーンズで代用)」 when DepthParallaxRenderer reports no depth — call `DepthParallaxRenderer.hasDepth(url:)`).
- Overlay selection: 「マスク」 and (images) 「3Dズーム」.
- Text/overlay selection: 「トラッキング」: user draws a rectangle on the preview around the target at the current time (PreviewGestureOverlay rect-selection mode) → MotionTracker.track(url: main clip under playhead, start: source time, end: min(clip.endTime, source time + item remaining duration × speed)) → converts to item keyframes (time relative to item start) and sets `keyframes` (history.record first).
- Root toolbar: 「おまかせ編集」 → AutoEditView sheet (style, target length, BGM pick (existing), title text, toggles; 「ハイライトを解析」 shows segments list with scores; 「作成」 → AutoEditor.build → replace project (history.record; confirm)), 「テンプレート」 (AutoEditor.templates list → applies with the current clips), 「スライドショー」 (PhotosPicker images → AutoEditor.slideshow), 「AI台本」 → ScriptWriterView (topic, length, tone; 「字幕から構成案」 → ScriptWriter.outline → add chapter markers; 「台本を作る」 → lines list editable → 「読み上げて挿入」 uses TextToSpeech per line at its time → narration clips; 「字幕として挿入」 → SubtitleCues).
- SubtitleEditorView: add 「AIで翻訳(文脈を見て自然に)」 button using SubtitlePolisher.translate(cues, from: selectedLanguage, toEnglish: true, settings: AppSettings.shared) with progress; keep the Apple translation button.
- All long analyses show a progress overlay with cancel (Task cancellation) and Japanese status.

## Integration order
V, A, P, U in parallel → reviewer per partition → cross-check (names: MaskRenderer, DepthParallaxRenderer.hasDepth/image, VisionReframe.analyze, MotionTracker.track, Stabilizer.analyze, HighlightAnalyzer.analyze, AutoEditor.build/slideshow/templates, ScriptWriter.write/outline, SubtitlePolisher.translate).
